headword: {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}
gloss: smooth talk; sweet words; lip service

definitions.gloss: smooth talk; glib talk; relying on words alone
definitions.explanation: Talking skillfully with words but without genuine substance or follow-through. Implies that someone's actions or character do not match their polished speech. Often used critically.

examples.japanese: {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{切|き}ろう→乗り切る：11410_norikiru⟧とした。
examples.english: He tried to get through the situation with smooth talk alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧うのみにして⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: He's all smooth talk, so don't take what he says at face value.

examples.japanese: {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|た}けている→長ける：14540_takeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実行力|じっこうりょく}→実行力：08705_jikkouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: He is skilled at moving people with clever words, but lacks the ability to follow through.

notes:
⟦{口先|くちさき}→口先：16728_kuchisaki⟧ (tip of the tongue; one's words) + {三寸|さんずん} (three sun, a short traditional measure — referring to the small space of the mouth). Together: suggesting talk with no real substance behind it.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ごまかす: to gloss over with smooth words
- {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧: a glib person, someone all talk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: all talk — more colloquial and blunt
- ⟦{建前|たてまえ}→建前：06621_tatemae⟧: stated principle vs. actual intention — more specific to social pretense
